from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485477/attempts/121aa726ce1d47daa341412ab2c8dccb/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-1ffb3608.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] in (1, 2)]
    (r, c, a), (tr, tc, b) = sorted(points, key=lambda p: p[2])
    sr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    sc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    while abs(tr-r) > 1 and abs(tc-c) > 1:
        r += sr
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tr-r) > 1:
        r += sr
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tc-c) > 1:
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_program',program_path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo=[[0]*12 for _ in range(13)]; demo[3][11]=2; demo[10][1]=1
result=mod.transform(demo)
expected=[[0]*12 for _ in range(13)]; expected[3][11]=2; expected[10][1]=1
for r,c in [(4,7),(4,8),(4,9),(4,10),(5,6),(6,5),(7,4),(8,3),(9,2)]: expected[r][c]=3
print('demo match:', result==expected)
test=[[0]*16 for _ in range(16)]; test[1][4]=1; test[13][12]=2
answer=mod.transform(test)
print(answer)
